examples.title: Use a current GPS fix
examples.code:
GPS begin RX [16] TX [17]
repeat [100]
  GPS update
  if (GPS valid position?)
    GPS coordinate [gps;latitude (deg x 106)] : text? [true]
  wait [100] milliseconds
GPS close
examples.explanation: Match pins to the connected NMEA receiver. A fix may take longer than this ten-second demonstration; no output is preferable to treating an invalid cached coordinate as a real location.
